components.css: .ds-notepad { position: relative; display: grid; grid-template-columns: 1fr auto; grid-template-rows: auto 1fr; gap: var(--space-md, 1rem); min-height: 11.5rem; padding: 1.5rem; padding-top: 2.5rem; padding-bottom: 3rem; border: 1px solid var(--color-paper-muted, oklch(0.9 0.014 84.58)); border-radius: var(--radius-note, 0.4rem); background: var(--color-paper-raised, oklch(0.975 0.009 84.58)); color: var(--color-field-violet, oklch(0.4502 0.1397 295.24)); box-shadow: var(--shadow-note, 0 0.25rem 0.75rem oklch(0.2556 0.0159 307.77 / 0.09)); text-decoration: none; transition: transform 160ms cubic-bezier(0.2, 0.8, 0.2, 1), box-shadow 160ms cubic-bezier(0.2, 0.8, 0.2, 1); } .ds-notepad::after { content: ""; position: absolute; right: 1.5rem; bottom: 1.5rem; left: 1.5rem; height: 0.6rem; background-image: radial-gradient(circle at 0.3rem center, transparent 0 0.22rem, currentColor 0.22rem 0.3rem, transparent 0.3rem), linear-gradient(currentColor, currentColor); background-position: left center, right center; background-repeat: no-repeat; background-size: auto, calc(100% - 0.6rem) 1px; } .ds-notepad-icon { grid-column: 1 / -1; width: 3.4rem; height: 3.4rem; fill: none; stroke: currentColor; stroke-width: 1.1; stroke-linecap: round; } .ds-notepad-title { align-self: end; color: var(--color-soft-charcoal, oklch(0.2556 0.0159 307.77)); font-family: 'Cormorant SC', Georgia, serif; font-size: 1.85rem; font-weight: 500; letter-spacing: -0.045em; line-height: 0.96; text-transform: uppercase; } .ds-notepad-arrow { align-self: end; font-size: 1.85rem; line-height: 0.96; } .ds-notepad:hover { box-shadow: var(--shadow-paper, 0 0.5rem 1.5rem oklch(0.2556 0.0159 307.77 / 0.07)); transform: translateY(-0.25rem); } .ds-notepad:active { transform: scale(0.985); } .ds-notepad:focus-visible { outline: 0.125rem solid var(--color-field-violet, oklch(0.4502 0.1397 295.24)); outline-offset: 0.25rem; }

components.css: .ds-band-row { display: flex; gap: 1.5rem; align-items: center; padding: 1.5rem; background: var(--color-aubergine, oklch(0.2924 0.0488 293.35)); color: var(--color-on-aubergine, oklch(0.94 0.015 84.58)); font-size: 0.875rem; font-weight: 600; letter-spacing: 0.12em; text-transform: uppercase; } .ds-archive-label { color: var(--color-on-aubergine-muted, oklch(0.78 0.025 310)); } .ds-archive-sep { color: var(--color-collegiate-coral-soft, oklch(0.6985 0.1589 36.85)); font-weight: 700; } .ds-archive-link { padding-bottom: 0.5rem; border-bottom: 1px solid var(--color-collegiate-coral-soft, oklch(0.6985 0.1589 36.85)); color: inherit; text-decoration: none; } .ds-archive-link:hover { color: var(--color-paper, oklch(0.9486 0.0165 79.35)); border-color: var(--color-on-aubergine, oklch(0.94 0.015 84.58)); } .ds-archive-link:focus-visible { outline: 0.125rem solid var(--color-collegiate-coral-soft, oklch(0.6985 0.1589 36.85)); outline-offset: 0.25rem; }

components.name: Travel Print
components.description: White-bordered photographic print with washi tape and a caption label.
components.css: .ds-print { position: relative; width: 14rem; margin: 1.5rem; padding: 0.75rem; border-radius: var(--radius-print, 0.2rem); background: var(--color-paper-raised, oklch(0.975 0.009 84.58)); box-shadow: var(--shadow-paper, 0 0.5rem 1.5rem oklch(0.2556 0.0159 307.77 / 0.07)); transform: rotate(1.25deg); } .ds-print-photo { aspect-ratio: 1 / 1; background: linear-gradient(160deg, oklch(0.72 0.06 250), oklch(0.5 0.08 150)); } .ds-print-tape { position: absolute; top: -1rem; left: 50%; width: 5.5rem; height: 2.6rem; background: var(--color-field-violet-soft, oklch(0.72 0.07 295.24)); clip-path: polygon(0 8%, 1.5% 0, 98% 3%, 100% 10%, 98.8% 32%, 100% 52%, 98.5% 78%, 100% 94%, 97.5% 100%, 2% 97%, 0 88%, 1.2% 66%, 0 42%, 1% 18%); opacity: 0.9; transform: translateX(-50%) rotate(-1deg); } .ds-print figcaption { position: relative; padding-top: 0.5rem; color: var(--color-caption-ink, oklch(0.5 0.02 60)); font-size: 0.875rem; font-style: italic; text-align: center; }

narrative.overview: Everything on this site behaves like a physical object in a well-kept travel journal: cream notepads with spiral-binding keyholes, photographic prints with white borders and washi tape, ruled note paper, dashed map routes with ring nodes and crosses, and one deep aubergine journal-cover band with a stitched diamond lattice. Warmth and tactility come from material detail, never from aging effects. The system rejects the antique and the corporate in equal measure: no parchment, sepia, vignettes, or distressed textures on one side; no SaaS cards, dashboard shells, or hero-metric templates on the other.
keyCharacteristics: Materials are sampled or hand-drawn, never synthesized generically
Asymmetric collage layout with controlled overlap across section boundaries
Closed set of grounds: Warm Paper, Paper Raised, Deep Aubergine
Color is role-coded: violet = countries, coral = places
Motion is restrained: entrance and hover only, nothing over 400ms

rules.name: The Closed-Ground Rule
rules.body: Surfaces are Warm Paper, Paper Raised, or Deep Aubergine. A token scale step is not a sanctioned surface; propose new grounds, never apply them unilaterally.

rules.name: The Dark-Band Coral Rule
rules.body: On Deep Aubergine, interactive affordances (underlines, rings, focus) are Collegiate Coral Soft, never Field Violet (1.8:1, invisible).

rules.name: The Two-Family Rule
rules.body: Redesigned surfaces use exactly Cormorant SC and Avenir Next. The monospace in the interior pages' shell is starter residue slated for replacement and must not spread to new work.

rules.name: The Whisper-Shadow Rule
rules.body: Shadow opacity never exceeds 0.09. Depth comes from overlap and rotation, not from lift.

dos: Do source every color, size, spacing, and radius from src/styles/tokens.css via var(--*); new values land in tokens first.
Do keep every design-token change in sync with /showcase in the same change.
Do keep rotations between 1 and 4.5 degrees and overlaps deliberate; collage, not clutter.
Do gate hover transforms behind (hover: hover) and keep all motion within 400ms, entrance and hover only, honoring reduced motion.
Do keep About Me reachable but quieter than the two primary destinations on every breakpoint, per PRODUCT.md.
donts: Don't use antique parchment, medieval manuscript styling, heavy vignette, or sepia photography.
Don't paint full-purple light sections; Deep Aubergine is the only committed dark ground.
Don't invent fake coordinates, telemetry, archive codes, or travel facts.
Don't hide navigation or gate it behind hover-only interactions.
Don't build generic SaaS cards or a conventional dashboard shell.
Don't put Field Violet affordances on the aubergine band (The Dark-Band Coral Rule).
Don't introduce a third type family on redesigned surfaces (The Two-Family Rule).
